reader_summary.headline: Scott Bessent is the CEO and CIO of Key Square Group and a renowned global macro investor.
reader_summary.overview: Scott Bessent is the CEO and CIO of Key Square Group and a renowned global macro investor. His 40-year investment career has included two stints at Soros Fund Management. In between, Scott launched a hedge fund, retired, and joined me at Protégé Partners when he learned retirement wasn't for him.

key_points.text: His 40-year investment career has included two stints at Soros Fund Management.
Following his second tour at Soros, Scott started Key Square with $4.5 billion, one of the largest hedge fund launches in history.
Scott has been profiled in two best-selling investment books, Steve Drobny's Inside the House of Money and Sebastian Mallaby's More Money than God .
